fusions.name: Relay Call
fusions.desc: Sings a call that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then passes to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that each. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Dropped Anchor
fusions.desc: Drops a deep-sea weight on the target, which deals 32 damage, plus 5% of maximum health to a boss or elite. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Next Phrase
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Echo Down the Line
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, an answering note leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
